About me

Two journeys,
one grounded perspective.

Balkrishna Upadhyay is an IT student with a growing interest in software and web technologies, while continuing the living practice of Karmakand and Hindu rituals. These are complementary ways of serving people: one honours roots, the other creates new possibilities.

ॐ

Traditional Journey

Pandit / Karmakand practice guided by care, cultural understanding, and respect for each family’s needs.

Technology Journey

IT study and hands-on exploration of web, software, data, and thoughtful digital experiences.
